WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    ordersmark,
    AVG(fillcount) as avg_fillcount
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) as overall_avg_fillcount
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.ordersmark,
    s1.avg_fillcount,
    s1.avg_fillcount - s2.overall_avg_fillcount as diff_from_overall
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
  WHERE s1.avg_fillcount > s2.overall_avg_fillcount
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) as secondary_avg_fillcount
  FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT 
    s3.ordersmark,
    s3.avg_fillcount,
    s3.diff_from_overall,
    s3.avg_fillcount - s4.secondary_avg_fillcount as diff_from_secondary
  FROM step3 s3
  CROSS JOIN step4 s4
  WHERE s3.avg_fillcount > s4.secondary_avg_fillcount
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_fillcount) as col2_avg,
  AVG(diff_from_overall) as col3_avg,
  AVG(diff_from_secondary) as col4_avg
FROM step5
